edge_explainer: FRAME-REJECT: there is no company-specific de-rate to court, and this name is also the batch's decisive GATE DEFECT. DECOMPOSITION: CCJ 3mo -29.8% vs URA -30.8% / URNM -29.1%; 6mo -35.4% vs URA -34.1%. Regressed on URA over 3 years: beta 1.01, raw drawdown -40.0%, residual -20.3%, RESIDUAL SHARE 0.51 - below the 0.60 threshold, so factor_costume should have fired and applied the x0.30 demote. CAUSE-CHECK finds no adverse company event: Q2-2026 reported 07-31 as 'Year-to-Date Performance on Track; Production Outlook Unchanged', EPS missed by $0.13 but the REVENUE OUTLOOK WAS RAISED and the shares rose on the print. THE GATE DEFECT: quality_drawdown.py line ~125 keys FACTOR_PROXY on the yfinance SECTOR. CCJ's sector is 'Energy' -> XLE (oil & gas). CCJ's INDUSTRY is literally 'Uranium'. Against XLE the beta is 0.34 and the residual share is 1.03, so factor_costume evaluated FALSE, no demote fired, and CCJ entered the queue at score 68.9. With the correct proxy: 68.9 x 0.30 = 20.7 and it never appears. This is the AEM lesson recurring inside the gate built from AEM - the logic is right, the lookup is too coarse. FIX: an industry->proxy map consulted BEFORE the sector map (Uranium->URA, Gold->GLD, Copper->COPX, Steel->SLX, Lithium->LIT, Coal->KOL, Shipping->BDRY). It also fails the tier-1/2 frame on its own terms: trailing P/E 84.6x, forward 47.2x, FCF $50M on a $39.1B cap (0.13% yield), revenue growth -7.2%. That is a commodity producer at a peak-cycle multiple whose commodity is falling, not quality at an own-history discount. Also NOT falling on any 52-week definition: +28% off a 345-day-old low. TOP UNVERIFIABLE: no XBRL - Cameco is a Canadian 40-F filer and data.sec.gov returned no us-gaap facts for CIK 1009001, so every fundamental here is yfinance-sourced rather than audited-primary. Tolerable for a REJECT; would not be for a BUY.
